statement.ru: Гром — это звук, с которым сталкиваются облака.
statement.en: Thunder is the sound of clouds bumping into each other.

why: Thunder comes from air superheated by lightning expanding violently, not from colliding clouds.

statement.ru: Снежинки на самом деле прозрачные — белым снег только кажется.
statement.en: Snowflakes are really clear; snow only looks white.

why: Snow is clear ice; light scattering off the crystal facets makes it look white.

statement.ru: Северный ветер дует на север.
statement.en: A north wind blows towards the north.

why: Winds are named for where they come from: a north wind blows from the north to the south.

statement.ru: Бывают градины крупнее грейпфрута.
statement.en: Hailstones can be bigger than a grapefruit.

why: The record hailstone (Vivian, South Dakota, 2010) was 20 cm across.

statement.ru: Мобильный телефон в руке притягивает молнию.
statement.en: A mobile phone in your hand attracts lightning.

why: NWS: metal, including phones, makes no difference to where lightning strikes.

statement.ru: Облака состоят из водяного пара.
statement.en: Clouds are made of water vapour.

why: Clouds are tiny liquid droplets and ice crystals; water vapour itself is invisible.

statement.ru: Самое жаркое время лета приходится на самый длинный день года.
statement.en: The hottest part of summer falls on the longest day of the year.

why: Seasonal lag: peak warmth comes about a month after the solstice.

statement.ru: Если гром слышен через 3 секунды после вспышки, гроза примерно в километре.
statement.en: If thunder comes 3 seconds after the flash, the storm is about a kilometre away.

why: Sound covers about 1 km in 3 s; divide the seconds by three for kilometres.

statement.ru: Небо голубое, потому что в нём отражается океан.
statement.en: The sky is blue because it reflects the ocean.

why: The sky is blue because air molecules scatter blue sunlight most (Rayleigh scattering).

statement.ru: В Сахаре иногда идёт снег.
statement.en: It sometimes snows in the Sahara.

why: Ain Sefra, a Saharan town in Algeria, had snow in 1979, 2016, 2017, 2018 and later.

statement.ru: Ураганы называют в честь учёных, которые их заметили первыми.
statement.en: Hurricanes are named after the scientists who spotted them first.

why: Names come from fixed lists that rotate from year to year and alternate male and female names.

statement.ru: Ураганам когда-то давали только женские имена.
statement.en: Hurricanes were once given only women's names.

why: Atlantic hurricanes got only female names from 1953; male names were added in 1979.

statement.ru: Роса — это капли, которые ночью падают с неба.
statement.en: Dew is drops that fall from the sky at night.

why: Dew condenses straight onto cooled surfaces from the air; it does not fall.

statement.ru: Молния может ударить, даже когда над головой ясное небо.
statement.en: Lightning can strike even when the sky overhead is clear.

why: NWS: 'bolts from the blue' can strike 10-15 miles from the storm.

statement.ru: Больше всего торнадо в мире бывает в США.
statement.en: The USA has more tornadoes than any other country.

why: The US has by far the most tornadoes, about 1,200 a year.

statement.ru: Открытые окна спасают дом от торнадо: давление выравнивается.
statement.en: Open windows save a house from a tornado by equalising the pressure.

why: A myth: the pressure drop does little damage, and opening windows can make damage worse.

statement.ru: При −40 градусах Цельсий и Фаренгейт показывают одно и то же.
statement.en: At −40 degrees, Celsius and Fahrenheit show the same number.

why: −40 °F equals −40 °C; the scales cross there.

statement.ru: На Северном полюсе холоднее, чем на Южном.
statement.en: The North Pole is colder than the South Pole.

why: The South Pole is colder: it sits 2,800 m high on a continent; the North Pole is on the sea.

statement.ru: Верхушка грозового облака бывает выше Эвереста.
statement.en: The top of a thundercloud can be higher than Everest.

why: Cumulonimbus tops usually reach 12 km and can pass 20 km; Everest is 8.8 km.

statement.ru: Бывает розовый снег — его окрашивают водоросли.
statement.en: There is pink snow, coloured by algae.

why: 'Watermelon snow': the alga Chlamydomonas nivalis turns snow red or pink.

statement.ru: Большинство молний бьёт в землю.
statement.en: Most lightning strikes the ground.

why: Cloud-to-ground flashes are only about 25 % of all lightning; the rest stay in the clouds.

statement.ru: В Южном полушарии ураганы закручиваются по часовой стрелке.
statement.en: In the Southern Hemisphere, hurricanes spin clockwise.

why: Tropical cyclones turn clockwise south of the equator because of the Coriolis effect.

statement.ru: Иногда на небе видно сразу три солнца.
statement.en: Sometimes you can see three suns in the sky at once.

why: Sun dogs (parhelia): bright spots on both sides of the Sun made by ice crystals.

statement.ru: Капля дождя падает быстрее 100 км/ч.
statement.en: A raindrop falls faster than 100 km/h.

why: A 3 mm drop falls at about 8 m/s, around 30 km/h.

statement.ru: В Нью-Йорке за год выпадает больше дождя, чем в Лондоне.
statement.en: New York gets more rain in a year than London.

why: New York averages about 1,270 mm a year, London about 600 mm.

statement.ru: Бывает гроза с молниями прямо во время снегопада.
statement.en: A thunderstorm with lightning can happen during a snowfall.

why: Thundersnow: a thunderstorm in which snow falls instead of rain.

statement.ru: Бывает дождь, который испаряется, не долетев до земли.
statement.en: Some rain evaporates before it reaches the ground.

why: Virga: rain that evaporates on its way down.

statement.ru: Температуру воздуха для прогноза меряют на самом солнцепёке.
statement.en: Weather stations measure air temperature in full sunshine.

why: Thermometers sit in a white louvred box that keeps direct sunlight off them.

statement.ru: В Долине Смерти в США воздух нагревался выше +50 °C.
statement.en: In Death Valley, USA, the air has been hotter than 50 °C.

why: Death Valley holds the official world record, 56.7 °C, and has passed 54 °C in recent years.

statement.ru: В Великобритании торнадо случаются каждый год.
statement.en: Britain has tornadoes every year.

why: The UK averages about 33 tornadoes a year, among the most per area in the world.

statement.ru: Если стрелка барометра быстро падает, жди ясной погоды.
statement.en: If the barometer needle drops fast, expect clear weather.

why: A rapid pressure drop means a low is coming and rain is more likely.

statement.ru: В облаках вода может оставаться жидкой даже при −30 °C.
statement.en: In clouds, water can stay liquid even at −30 °C.

why: Supercooled cloud droplets stay liquid down to about −38 °C.

statement.ru: Одна молния может протянуться больше чем на 700 километров.
statement.en: A single lightning flash can stretch more than 700 kilometres.

why: The record flash (Texas to Kansas, 2017) was 829 km long.

statement.ru: У снежинки-звёздочки восемь лучей.
statement.en: A star-shaped snowflake has eight arms.

why: Ice is hexagonal, so snowflake stars have six arms.

statement.ru: Бывает, что вместе с дождём с неба падают рыбы.
statement.en: Sometimes fish fall from the sky along with the rain.

why: Rains of fish and frogs are recorded worldwide, e.g. Texarkana, Texas, 2021.

statement.ru: Бывает белая радуга.
statement.en: There is such a thing as a white rainbow.

why: A fog bow, made by tiny fog droplets, is sometimes called a white rainbow.
